cases.refreshed: Come play chess and make new friends in a fun and relaxed environment! This program is for children in grades K-8. Registration is not required but space is limited. This program is not a class. Attendees are expected to know the rules of chess and must be able to play independently. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities. Storytime is a fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of reading and learning for all ages. This program is geared for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers! Storytime: 10:30 AM - 10:55 AM. Free, with limited capacity. Seating for Storytime is available on a first-come, first-served basis. A limited number of tickets will be distributed at the Information Desk 30 minutes prior to the start of Storytime. Storytime will be held in the Community (in case of incremental weather/facility issues, storytime will be held in the Children's area.) This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

events.title: Community Threads: Lunar New Year Felt Goat

cases.refreshed: It's the year of the goat! In this workshop folks will make a felt goat for Lunar New Year. We will be only hand sewing in this workshop. Open to teens and adults only. Workshop suitable for the advanced beginner, intermediate, or advanced sewist. Knowledge of hand sewing and the sewing machine is required. You should know how to thread the machine, fill the bobbin, and use the backstitch, and you should understand the various other parts and functions of the sewing machine.
